nodes.label: LineOfSight.canSeeTileEntity (deci.a.c$a.a): 8 rays from the eye to the render box corners
nodes.rationale: PropRenderer draws a prop only if one of 8 corner rays is clear. Patched to return visible within 4 blocks and to try a ray to the box centre first.

nodes.label: TileEntityProp.getRenderBoundingBox: bare 1x1x1 cell for 36 of 72 props, never rotated
nodes.rationale: Models are drawn up to about 1.5 blocks wide and turn by metadata % 4 * 90, but the box stays the unrotated cell, so corners land off screen or behind floors and walls while the model is in view; Forge frustum culling uses the same box. Patched box: centred on the block, rotation proof, at least 2x2, covers the declared render size, half a block taller.

nodes.norm_label: tileentityprop.getrenderboundingbox: bare 1x1x1 cell for 36 of 72 props, never rotated

nodes.rationale: Prevents a new Javassist patch from silently discarding an earlier patch already applied to the same class in Decimation.jar.patched.

nodes.label: Bug: generated metal shelves invisible (multiblock master never set, fixed v0.12.3)
nodes.rationale: Reported 7 Oktober 2026; the culling patch did not fix it. World generation places the block directly, so the placement code that sets the master never runs and the stored master stays 0,0,0. Found by reading multibl.mx/my/mz = 0 in tile entity NBT of a generated world. Verified: new world 407/407 shelves are masters; a copy of the user pre fix world repaired in the loaded area, the rest repairs when visited.
nodes.norm_label: bug: generated metal shelves invisible (multiblock master never set, fixed v0.12.3)

nodes.label: MetalShelfRenderer draws only the master part (returns unless isMaster: stored master position equals own position)
nodes.rationale: Multiblock props (tile entities extending deci.W.a MultiblockPart, e.g. deci:BlockMetalShelf, MetalShelf_Empty) rely on the block placement code to set the master; any part whose master was never set is never drawn.
nodes.norm_label: metalshelfrenderer draws only the master part (returns unless ismaster: stored master position equals own position)

nodes.label: setSelfMaster() on every placed multiblock part plus repair on chunk load
nodes.rationale: Slices and the small schematic placer call setSelfMaster(); MultiblockRepairHandler makes orphaned parts their own master on chunk load, which also repairs worlds generated before 0.12.3 and legacy Decimation props broken the same way.
nodes.norm_label: setselfmaster() on every placed multiblock part plus repair on chunk load

nodes.label: v0.12.3 rule: multiblock props (deci.W.a, metal shelves) render only from a master part; anything placing them outside player placement must call setSelfMaster()
nodes.rationale: Done in Slices and the small placer, plus MultiblockRepairHandler on chunk load.
nodes.norm_label: v0.12.3 rule: multiblock props (deci.w.a, metal shelves) render only from a master part; anything placing them outside player placement must call setselfmaster()
